verdict.rationale: Pulumi runs a public Pulumi Registry with 316 packages, including AWS, Azure Native, Google Cloud and Kubernetes. Every supported language can consume the full surface of registry providers, and component libraries such as AWSx are referenced. The registry also explicitly invites users to contribute their own packages. Missing for 10: documentation of the publishing/authoring workflow for components, detail on consuming reusable components (vs. providers) as modules, and independent or hands-on corroboration of registry consume/publish.
